method: V12 compass set with corrected GPT Image 2 horizontal left and right endpoints plus a regenerated right-to-bottom-right midpoint; the final right endpoint is a direct masked GPT Image 2 edit that preserves the accepted smaller head while restoring the prior right endpoint's body framing

constraints.uniformResize: left and right generation sources: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254; regenerated right-to-bottom-right midpoint: uniform 2.9% pre-key scale plus a final uniform 1.1% endpoint-alignment scale

inputs: prior V13 left endpoint: edit target for framing, scale, crop, shoulders, wardrobe, and horizontal pose correction
top-left.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference

regeneratedEndpoints.editMask: head and upper neck preserved; lower-body edit begins below y=500 with a 200-pixel transition into the fully editable body region
inputs: accepted smaller V13 right endpoint: masked edit target and sole authority for head, face, hair, neck, glasses, beard, level 3 o'clock pose, and lighting
prior V13 right endpoint: fixed body-framing reference for shoulder tips, torso width, collar, clothing geometry, placement, and bottom crop
top-right.webp: fixed supporting hair-identity reference only
bottom-right.webp: fixed supporting body-proportion reference only

rebuiltTransition.alignment: uniformly resized generated 1280x1280 source to 1317x1317, then extracted a 1280x1280 canvas at x=22, y=16 before alpha extraction; after restoring the right body framing, uniformly resized the keyed 1254x1254 midpoint to 1268x1268 and extracted a 1254x1254 canvas at x=7, y=0
inputs: corrected right endpoint source: authoritative start pose, identity, scale, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
bottom-right.webp: authoritative end pose, scale, placement, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
center.webp: supporting identity and wardrobe reference
